targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM telemetry_serving.provider_activity_summary ORDER BY last_occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM telemetry_serving.sdar_smpp_execution_topology ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, concat(ResourceAttributes['telemetry.source.deployment_id'], '/', if(ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] != '', ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'], ResourceAttributes['telemetry.source.runtime_instance_id']), '/', MetricName, '/', toString(cityHash64(toJSONString(mapSort(ResourceAttributes)), toJSONString(mapSort(Attributes)), ScopeName, ScopeVersion, toJSONString(mapSort(ScopeAttributes)), MetricUnit))) AS series, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS value
FROM telemetry_observability.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  AND ResourceAttributes['telemetry.collection.protocol'] = ${protocol:sqlstring}
  AND (${deployment:sqlstring} = '' OR ResourceAttributes['telemetry.source.deployment_id'] = ${deployment:sqlstring})
  AND (${runtime:sqlstring} = '' OR ResourceAttributes['service.instance.id'] = ${runtime:sqlstring} OR ResourceAttributes['telemetry.source.runtime_instance_id'] = ${runtime:sqlstring})
  AND MetricName IN ('telemetry_audit_backlog')
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time, series
